title: Committed WAIT_CALC native full-calculation recovery

criteria.source: Live 2026-10-15 native gate helpers and atomic CALC hash; actual installed EXE FormShipmentDistribution FIX/CANCEL then separate CALC0
criteria.scope: year/week from same locked committed V2 WAIT_CALC row only; pending full-product scope ProdKey=0
criteria.grace: 60 seconds from SQL GETDATE, only yields to normal EXE follow-up; never a RUN expiry
criteria.locking: UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK,NOWAIT, then original transaction SPID/count/state and transaction-owned application-lock marker
criteria.completion: Native returnCode and output result both numeric zero; same original transaction; fully idle gate; commit acknowledged
criteria.retry: 15 second poll; fingerprint-specific durable max5 attempts, 30/60/120/240/300second backoff; exhausted scope pauses with persistent status and stderr warning; new token has separate budget
criteria.process: production opt-in only after Next prepare; dedicated child/pool, 90second request timeout and120second OS termination deadline; parent waits process close before another attempt
criteria.uncertainty: Unknown commit or process death is not replayed blindly; next iteration rereads locked gate. status.json is last report, not authoritative DB state

sideEffects.StockMaster/ProductStock: existing native calculation only, including later snapshots as original SP
sideEffects.NenovaStockWeekGate: existing native enter/leave only; no direct clear or RUN reclaim
sideEffects.diagnostics: persistent outside deployment folder; attempt scope/token and safe code/number/phase; no credentials or SQL bodies
